title: A memorable neighbour or classmate
prompt: Tell me about someone you met who left an impression on you. Who were they, what happened, and why do you remember them?
speaking_goal: Tell a personal story in the past tense.

title: A technology that changed your life
prompt: Describe a technology that changed how you live or work. What was life like before, and what is different now?

title: Give a clear daily stand-up
prompt: Give a two-sentence-per-point stand-up: what you did yesterday, what you will do today, and any blockers.

title: Hand over work to a teammate
prompt: You are going on holiday. Explain to a teammate what they need to know to take over your work.

title: Push back on extra scope
prompt: A stakeholder asks for extra features without extra time. Explain politely why this is a problem and offer options.

title: Explain a root cause analysis
prompt: Walk through how you would find the root cause of a slow report or failing job, step by step.

title: Explain how you review code
prompt: Explain what you look for when reviewing a teammate’s work and how you give feedback.

title: Your greatest strength with evidence
prompt: Name one strength and prove it with a specific example from your experience.

title: Where do you see yourself in five years?
prompt: Describe where you want to be in five years and the steps you are taking to get there.
speaking_goal: Talk about the future with confidence.

title: A tough ethical choice at work
prompt: Discuss a situation where doing the right thing is costly. What would you do, and why?
